transcript.reasoning:
We need to create a plate map listing source wells content transferred to destination wells consecutively from A1 onward. No specifics about liquid type, just copying. So we treat each source well containing some unspecified liquid "source@{well}". Destination gets 10 ul of that liquid per well. No other reagents. We'll define liquid template@{well} bind well with pattern .+. Count not needed because each is distinct. Provide variant only (since destinations consecutive start at A1 - direction ambiguous? Could be column-major or row-major, need two variants). Since request doesn't specify orientation, we note assumption. Provide two variants: column-major and row-major. Use pinned mapping accordingly.

First identify source wells list: B3,C7,D1,A12,H6,E5,F9,G2,B11,C4.

Destination wells consecutive starting at A1: For column-major (down column then next column): order A1,B1,C1,D1,E1,F1,G1,H1,A2,... Let's map 10 wells: A1,B1,C1,D1,E1,F1,G1,H1,A2,B2.

For row-major (left-to-right rows): A1,A2,A3,A4,A5,A6,A7,A8,A9,A10.

Provide both variants.

Define liquid: "source@{well}" role sample bind well pattern ".+" maybe we need generic catch-all. Also could define specific liquids for each source? Simpler: one liquid representing any source well content. But we need to track which source goes where; we can use "source@{well}" with bind well pattern ".+"; each instance gets name based on well. Good.

Thus liquids list: one entry with pattern ".+" binds well, role sample.

No other liquids.

Variants: each with pinned dict mapping dest well to {"source@{src}":10}.

Compute mappings.

Column-major mapping index i from 0 to9:

dest wells: ['A1','B1','C1','D1','E1','F1','G1','H1','A2','B2']
source list as given.

Row-major mapping dest: ['A1','A2','A3','A4','A5','A6','A7','A8','A9','A10']

Now produce JSON.

Also notes: mention assumption about orientation.
